maddeler.e:
تستقرضوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِضُوا (tastaqriḍū) /tas.taq.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# تُسْتَقْرَضُوا (tustaqraḍū) /tus.taq.ra.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
